content.text:
Shipyard, Tavern and Market
arrive in Phase 5

events.comment: PORT (Phase 1 stub). Full harbor with Shipyard/Tavern/Market is Phase 5.

SAILING SCENE -- logic lives in external events, one per manager.
VoyageManager: voyage state machine, distance, ocean scroll, sinking.
EncounterManager: spawning, approach, decisions, parley outcomes.
CombatManager: volleys, projectiles, damage, ammo, combat outcomes.
UIManager: layout, HUD, buttons. Buttons only record Sailing.PendingAction;
managers act on it next frame (cleared at the end of CombatManager). UI last.

VOYAGE STATE MACHINE. Voyage.State holds exactly one of:
PORT, SAILING, ENCOUNTER_APPROACH, ENCOUNTER_DECISION, COMBAT, BOARDING,
PARLEY, TRADE, EVENT, REWARDS, RETURNING, SUNK.
Change state ONLY by setting Voyage.State and resetting Voyage.StateTime to 0.
Phase 2 uses: PORT, SAILING, ENCOUNTER_APPROACH, ENCOUNTER_DECISION, PARLEY,
COMBAT, REWARDS (outcome screen), RETURNING, SUNK.

events.name: Voyage start (new voyage every time this scene opens)
State timer (seconds spent in current state, frame-rate independent)
STATE: RETURNING (ship slows, then the Port scene opens)

events.comment: Phase 5 will bank Voyage.Gold / cargo into Player here before leaving.

events.name: ENCOUNTER STATES: ships slow down alongside each other
STATE: SUNK (hull reached 0: lose unbanked gold, keep permanent progress)

parameters: "Unbanked gold lost: " + ToString(Voyage.Gold) + NewLine() + "Your ships and upgrades are safe."

events.name: Ocean scroll (eases toward ScrollTarget; offsets wrap to stay small)

events.comment:
RESPONSIVE LAYOUT. Game uses 'scaleOuter': the 720x1280 reference is always
fully visible, taller phones get extra height, tablets get extra width.
Everything is positioned from SceneWindowWidth/Height, and recomputed only
when the window size changes (not every frame).
Settings.SafeTop/SafeBottom reserve space for notches / home indicators.

The water surfaces slide toward the camera by the same offsets the 2D ocean
used (wrapped at the texture size), so the tiling is seamless.

EnemyShip (2D, hidden Logic2D layer) is the logic object; EnemyShip3D copies its
centre and heading. Fading out (sunk) = going down bow-first while listing.

Roll (RotationY): sea swell + heel from firing a broadside + shudder when hit.
When the voyage is SUNK the ship goes down bow-first.

events.name: HUD refresh (5x per second, not every frame, to avoid re-rendering text)

parameters: "Hull " + ToString(Enemy.Hull) + "    Crew " + Enemy.Approx + ToString(Enemy.EstCrew) + "    Cannons " + Enemy.Approx + ToString(Enemy.EstCannons)
"They will sail on in " + ToString(ceil(Config.DecisionTimeout - Voyage.StateTime)) + "s"

events.name: Combat UI: enemy tag, reload bar, ammo selection

events.comment:
Enemy name + hull bar float above its masthead; your reload bar sits behind your
stern. Both are projected from 3D and clamped to stay on screen.

parameters: (LayoutW / 2 + ((EnemyCX) - LayoutW / 2) * CamF / (-((EnemyCY) - LayoutH / 2) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) - ((Config.ShipZ + U * 8.6) - Config.CamZ) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))))

(LayoutH / 2 - (-((EnemyCY) - LayoutH / 2) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) + ((Config.ShipZ + U * 8.6) - Config.CamZ) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))) * CamF / (-((EnemyCY) - LayoutH / 2) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) - ((Config.ShipZ + U * 8.6) - Config.CamZ) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))))
(LayoutW / 2 + ((ShipCX) - LayoutW / 2) * CamF / (-((ShipCY + ShipH / 2) - LayoutH / 2) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) - ((Config.ShipZ) - Config.CamZ) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))))

(LayoutH / 2 - (-((ShipCY + ShipH / 2) - LayoutH / 2) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) + ((Config.ShipZ) - Config.CamZ) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))) * CamF / (-((ShipCY + ShipH / 2) - LayoutH / 2) * sin(ToRad(Config.CamPitch)) - ((Config.ShipZ) - Config.CamZ) * cos(ToRad(Config.CamPitch))))

events.name: HUD buttons (UI only records the choice; managers act on it next frame)

events.comment:
ENCOUNTER MANAGER. One encounter at a time: the spawn timer only runs while
SAILING with no other ship present (Enemy.Active = 0). A single EnemyShip
instance is reused for every encounter (no create/delete per encounter).
Encounter types are data in the global EncounterTypes structure.
Combat itself lives in CombatManager.
Pass 1: total weight (weights shift with distance tier).
Pass 2: walk the list until the roll is used up.

parameters: Voyage.Hull / max(0.1, Enemy.Cannons * Enemy.CannonDamage * Enemy.Accuracy / Enemy.ReloadTime)
Enemy.Hull / max(0.1, Voyage.Cannons * Voyage.CannonDamage * Voyage.Accuracy / Voyage.ReloadTime)

events.comment: Some information is approximate: hostile captains hide their strength.

We are faster: the ship we catch up with comes in from the top of the screen in
Config.ApproachTime seconds and slows into place alongside, holds there during the
encounter, then (unless sunk) drifts back at Config.DriftSpeed out of the bottom.
Departures play after the outcome, once back to SAILING.
Ship fully gone: free the slot and schedule the next encounter.

events.name: Decision timeout (pirates attack, others sail on)
Flee chance (shown on the Flee button)
PARLEY outcome (weighted; full dialogue options come in a later phase)

events.comment: Merchant (not hostile)

parameters: "The " + Enemy.Name + " pays" + NewLine() + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold for safe passage."
"The captain of the " + Enemy.Name + NewLine() + "wishes you fair winds."
"The " + Enemy.Name + " refuses" + NewLine() + "to talk and sails on."

events.comment: Pirate (hostile)

parameters: "You hand over " + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold." + NewLine() + "The " + Enemy.Name + " lets you pass."
"The " + Enemy.Name + " honours" + NewLine() + "the code and sails off."

events.comment:
COMBAT MANAGER. Cannons fire automatically on reload timers. Every ball's
hit / damage / crew / sail effect is rolled by logic at the moment of firing;
the CannonBall object is only a visual and applies its stored result when it
lands, and only while the state is still COMBAT. Leaving COMBAT deletes all
balls in flight, so nothing can land after the fight is decided.
Spawned objects (CannonBall, Fx, DamageText) are deleted when done; the GDevelop
runtime recycles deleted instances, so this acts as a pool.
3D: balls fly from the sloop's real gun ports along a 3D arc; everything
spawned here lives on the FX overlay layer and is projected from (CX, CY, H).

events.name: Combat start (once each time COMBAT is entered)

parameters: "The " + Enemy.Name + " takes " + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold" + NewLine() + "and lets you sail away."
EnemyCX - 1 * ((1 - CannonBall.Long) * U * 2.3 + (1 - CannonBall.Hit) * (1 - CannonBall.Long) * RandomInRange(30, 170)) + CannonBall.Long * RandomInRange(-40, 40)
EnemyCY + (1 - CannonBall.Long) * RandomFloatInRange(-0.3, 0.3) * ShipH * (2 - CannonBall.Hit) + CannonBall.Long * (2 * floor(RandomFloat(1) * 2) - 1) * (ShipH * 0.55 + RandomInRange(20, 120))

events.comment: A badly damaged enemy may strike its colours instead of firing.

parameters: ShipCX - -1 * ((1 - CannonBall.Long) * U * 2.3 + (1 - CannonBall.Hit) * (1 - CannonBall.Long) * RandomInRange(30, 170)) + CannonBall.Long * RandomInRange(-40, 40)
ShipCY + (1 - CannonBall.Long) * RandomFloatInRange(-0.3, 0.3) * ShipH * (2 - CannonBall.Hit) + CannonBall.Long * (2 * floor(RandomFloat(1) * 2) - 1) * (ShipH * 0.55 + RandomInRange(20, 120))

events.comment: Launch: the ball's turn in the ripple has come -> place it at its gun's muzzle.
